simple.meaning: קָשָׂה (qâsâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a jug (from its shape).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Exodus, Numbers, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Exodus 25:29. Its contexts include offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָשָׂה (H7184).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H7184. qasah or qasvah [ קַשְׂוָה , Kö ii. 1, 165 ] noun feminine a kind of jug, jar , utensil of tabernacle and (Chronicles) temple; — plural קְשָׂוֺת Exod 37:16 ; 1Chr 28:19 ; construct הַנָּ֑סֶח קְשׂוֺת Num 4:7 jars of the drink-offering ; suffix (of table) Exod 25:29 .
definitions.rootNote: or קַשְׂוָה ; from an unused root meaning to be round ;
